newsitem.title: FRANCE: PRESS DIGEST - France - Le Monde June 4.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - France - Le Monde June 4.

text.p: These are leading stories in afternoon daily Le Monde.
-- The fight to succeed Alain Juppe as head of RPR Gaullist party seems to have spiralled out of President Chirac's control.
-- Some unions urge halt to plans to privatise Thomson-CSF, France Telecom, Aerospatiale, Dassault, Credit Lyonnais, GAN-CIC, Credit Foncier and Air France.
-- SNCF railway reform adopted in February, creating a new state holding company to own the rail infrastructure, is expected to be questioned by the new government.

-- New government is expected to amend Carignon law on media ownership, leading to reshuffling of stakes in television channels to prevent groups whose sales are generated by public contracts, such as public works groups, from exerting too much influence on the media.
